initialize_sam2_video_session: initialize a SAM2 video inference session for processing video frames with specified device and dtype
process_image_points_boxes: process images with input points, labels, and bounding boxes into normalized tensors for the model
add_points_boxes_to_video_frame: add interactive points or bounding boxes to a specific video frame in an inference session
add_masks_to_video_frame: add segmentation masks to a specific video frame in an inference session
post_process_masks: post-process raw model masks by removing padding, upsampling, and binarizing to original image size
